house.description: Method in which Pollution Control Agency ranks multicommunity projects for the point source implementation grant program adjusted.

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; adjusting how Pollution Control Agency ranks multicommunity projects for the point source implementation grant program; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 446A.073, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 446A.073, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 6.+]

[+Regional projects.+]

[+If multiple governmental units are engaging in a joint project, the authority must consider, for purposes of ranking on the Pollution Control Agency's project priority list, where each governmental unit in the joint project would rank and place the total project at the position of the highest-ranking governmental unit. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; adjusting how Pollution Control Agency ranks multicommunity projects for the point source implementation grant program; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 446A.073, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 446A.073, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 6.

Regional projects.

If multiple governmental units are engaging in a joint project, the authority must consider, for purposes of ranking on the Pollution Control Agency's project priority list, where each governmental unit in the joint project would rank and place the total project at the position of the highest-ranking governmental unit.
additions: If multiple governmental units are engaging in a joint project, the authority must consider, for purposes of ranking on the Pollution Control Agency's project priority list, where each governmental unit in the joint project would rank and place the total project at the position of the highest-ranking governmental unit.
